hubs.name: AI
hubs.line: AI that does real work, with people firmly in control.
does: Train people on AI for the tasks they actually do
Find the use cases worth building, and build them
Direct AI agents to create and test working software
Use AI as a research partner on unfamiliar technical problems
hubs.decision: Treat training as discovery: the people doing the work know where AI can help, so I collect their ideas and turn the best into applications.

hubs.name: People
hubs.line: Technology changes nothing until people trust it and use it.
does: Lead a regional team across four international sites
Work with global functions across time zones
Design and deliver training, then follow up
Explain problems simply, so that leaders can decide
hubs.decision: Before any certification control or new system, I start with the managers and the people on shift, and explain why it matters to them.

hubs.name: Enterprise technology
hubs.line: Reliable foundations for offices, plants and remote sites.
does: Infrastructure, servers, backup and disaster recovery
Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune and SharePoint
Cisco and N-Tron networks, firewalls and telephony
Service delivery from support desk to site readiness
hubs.decision: I choose the stable, long-term solution rather than only the fastest one, and rehearse changes before they touch production.

hubs.name: Industrial operations
hubs.line: IT that survives heat, dust and the production schedule.
does: Product tracking and material management systems
Shop-floor digital workflows and touchscreens
IT/OT connectivity, from machine to core network
Cycle-time monitoring and shutdown analysis
hubs.decision: Plan around production: site surveys and switch replacements happen in planned shutdowns, one building at a time.

hubs.name: Security and resilience
hubs.line: Security and continuity built into the work, not added afterwards.
does: Led Aramco Cyber Security Certification for the company
Secured connected devices over a year-long programme
Practitioner in ISO 27001, 27701, 22301, 31000 and 42001
Procedures, standards and audit readiness
hubs.decision: Go beyond the requirement when the risk is real. Nobody asked us to inspect every PC and laptop, and I took the lead on it anyway.

hubs.name: Business outcomes
hubs.line: Every connection on this map exists to reach this point.
does: Lower operating cost and consolidated suppliers
Certification ahead of schedule
Visibility for production management
A business that kept running through a crisis
hubs.decision: I own procurement, contracts and licensing as well as the technology, so every technical decision also has to make business sense.

traces.problem: A machine vanishes from the production application
steps: The machine is running, but the application can't see it. A new cable doesn't help.
I use online research and AI tools to find the manual for an unfamiliar interface device.
I eliminate each link between the machine and the network until one device is left.
I share the standard in a lessons-learned session with automation and maintenance.
The machine is visible again, and the fix is no longer known only to me.
traces.label: The machine that vanished

traces.problem: Daily escalation on the shop floor runs on paper
steps: The plant director asks for a solution. I start with every department's expectations.
I propose large touchscreens that suit the shop floor, and pilot in three buildings.
A provider builds the application, and IT requests are followed through in our ticketing system.
Escalation becomes clearer, paper use falls, and the plant adopts it.
traces.label: Paper on the shop floor

traces.problem: A key customer sets a three-month security deadline
steps: The business is at stake, so I explain that to management first.
I design the training myself, and deliver it across shifts.
We close control gaps with an authorised third party, and automate policy acknowledgement.
I take the lead on inspecting every endpoint, which nobody required.
Certified ahead of schedule, followed by a year securing every connected device.
traces.label: A three-month deadline

traces.problem: Employees need to learn how AI helps with real work
steps: I train around 300 employees on applying Copilot to everyday tasks.
The training surfaces ideas, and an initiative identifies the most valuable use cases.
The strongest findings become working applications.
AI becomes a working tool in the business.
traces.label: AI for everyone
